decisions_made: Access for SaaS (OIDC) as the upstream identity provider, following Cloudflare's documented pattern for workers-oauth-provider, instead of validating the self-hosted app's Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion on /authorize.
OAuth resource derived from the request origin (one provider per origin), so workers.dev, previews, custom domains and wrangler dev need no extra config.
Only identity claims (sub, email, name) are kept in grant props; the Access access token is discarded.
Refresh-token lifetime 7 days to match the Access application's 168h session.
Used Access destination path overrides (public allow-list) instead of moving the destination to /agents, so unknown paths stay behind Access.
OAUTH_KV uses the dedicated namespace asfdk-governance-OAUTH, not the SESSION/GOVERNANCE one.
